name: Hatch A Pet 🐈
desc:
Formerly Idle Hatching!

Welcome! 🐾

How to play:
🥚 Buy an egg and insert to the machine to start hatching!
🐕 Collect the hatched animal and equip it on your plot!
💸 Animals generate money for you, even while you’re away!
✨ Buy powerful eggs and gears to hatch powerful animals!

Features:
🙌 Hatch eggs completely hands-free; Do anything while your eggs are hatching!
🕑 Hatching and money generation run even when you’re gone!
🧪 Stack multiple mutations on your animals. There are no limits!
🌴 Personalize your plot to various themes for different buffs!
✨ Use items to boost your production and luck!
🔮 Hatch the rarest supernatural creatures…

💻 Available on PC, Mobile and Console.
Made by developers from 🇲🇾, 🇻🇳, 🇵🇭, and 🇸🇬.
